title: Recalibrating a Typed-Decision Model in an Afternoon: A Hands-On Recipe for Laya's Confidence Scores
abstract: arXiv:2611.16499v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A typed-decision model such as Laya reads a text and a list of options that the caller defines, for example ticket categories, and returns a probability for each option. Code around it compares the top probability with a threshold to answer, abstain or escalate to a person. Earlier work reports, for a Turkish model, that temperature scaling can raise held-out calibration error (ECE). This tutorial gives a five-step recipe (measure, diagnose, fit, validate, deploy) in 130 lines of numpy with standard methods, none new. On 1,065 synthetic, LLM-labelled items the released Laya checkpoint has a pooled ECE of 0.073 but a bucket-macro ECE of 0.143 (0.127-0.184), the mean over buckets (questions grouped by type and option count): the 12-option bucket is over-confident by +0.22, the three-to-five-option bucket under-confident by 0.05, and they cancel. translated_title: 一个下午重新校准类型化决策模型：Laya置信度分数的实用指南
translated_abstract: 诸如Laya之类的类型化决策模型读取一段文本以及调用者定义的选项列表（例如工单类别），并为每个选项返回一个概率。围绕该模型的代码将最高概率与阈值进行比较，以决定是回答、弃权还是升级给人工处理。早前的工作曾报告，对于一个土耳其语模型，温度缩放可能会提高留出集上的校准误差（ECE）。本教程提供了一个五步操作流程（测量、诊断、拟合、验证、部署），仅用130行numpy代码和标准方法实现，没有引入任何新方法。在1,065个由大语言模型标注的合成数据项上，已发布的Laya检查点的总体ECE为0.073，但分桶宏平均ECE为0.143（0.127-0.184），即各桶（按问题类型和选项数量分组）的平均值：12选项桶过于自信+0.22，三至五选项桶不够自信-0.05，两者相互抵消。单一全局温度会使总体ECE恶化（0.173）；而每个桶采用交叉拟合的温度……
tldr: 本文提供了一个用130行numpy代码、五步流程重新校准Laya类型化决策模型置信度的实用教程，揭示总体ECE会掩盖相互抵消的分桶级校准误差，并表明按桶交叉拟合的温度缩放比单一全局温度更有效。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a hands-on five-step recipe using 130 lines of numpy to recalibrate Laya's confidence scores, revealing that pooled ECE masks canceling bucket-level miscalibration, and per-bucket cross-fitted temperature scaling outperforms a single global temperature.
